aboutText: R.Bonnici Carpentry & Renovations is your trusted carpenter in Altona Meadows, Victoria. We specialise in home renovations, from modern kitchen and bathroom remodels to complete transformations. Our expertise covers lock-up and fixing, custom decking, pergolas, laundry renovations, and precise fit-off services. We bring quality craftsmanship to every project, ensuring your home reflects your style.
servicesText: At R.Bonnici Carpentry & Renovations, we provide expert carpentry services including full home renovations, bathroom and kitchen remodels, and custom outdoor features. Our skilled team ensures top-quality workmanship for decks, pergolas, laundry rooms, and more, all delivered with precision and care in Altona Meadows and surrounding areas.
